title: HustleBox v1.2.0 — Friends and the Cloud
message:
Big one. Sign in, save to the cloud, build a crew.

ACCOUNTS
• Sign in with Email/Password, Google (web), or as Anonymous Guest.
• Settings → Account now has the full sign-in flow.
• Anonymous accounts can be linked to a real account later.
• Capacitor users on Android: Email and Anonymous work in the APK; Google sign-in is web-only for now.

CLOUD SAVE
• Once signed in, your save auto-syncs to the cloud every few seconds.
• If you sign in on a new device that already has local progress, you get a one-time conflict prompt: 'Use Cloud' or 'Keep Local & Overwrite Cloud'.
• Sync status shows in Settings (Up to date / Syncing / Last sync failed).
• Works offline — changes queue and push when you're back online.

FRIENDS
• Friends tab is no longer Coming Soon.
• Your friend code is shown big with a QR code, copy button, and shareable invite link.
• Add friends three ways: paste a friend code, scan their QR, or open their invite link (?friend=CODE).
• See your crew with their names, codes, and a remove option.

UNDER THE HOOD
• Firestore database structure: /users/{uid} (public summary) and /users/{uid}/save/main (full save). Friend codes mapped at /friendCodes/{code}.
• Security rules included with this version — paste them into Firebase Console > Firestore > Rules before public launch.

No save data wiped. Local-only saves keep working as before — sign-in is optional.

entries.title: Friends and the Cloud
highlights: Email + Google + Anonymous sign-in (Settings → Account)
Cloud save with auto-sync every few seconds
Conflict resolution prompt when local and cloud both have progress
Friend system fully wired: your code, QR, invite link, manual entry
Add friends by code or via ?friend=CODE invite link
Friends list with remove option
Firestore-backed — works offline, syncs when reconnected
Capacitor caveat: Google sign-in is web-only for now

Profile story branches on rep × skill × experience × money
Extended end-of-shift cinematic with engine + walking + sleep audio
Skip cinematic button
Update Log redressed as paper receipts inside a chalkboard frame
Friends/Arcade/Achievements get chalkboard frame treatment

Fixed: DAY counter stuck at DAY 1
Fixed: phantom customer firing after end shift
